senses.gloss: m. (קנס; v. קֵיסָא) piece of wood, chip.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 22b">Sabb. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>בק׳</he> kindling a light from another light by means of a chip.
<cite ref="Chullin 105a:16">Ḥull. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>איכא בינייהו ק׳</he> the difference between them comes in, when you wash your hands over chips.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 33b:3">Ab. Zar. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ וכ׳</he> as to causing the pitch in a wine cask to melt off by holding a burning chip in it &c.—[<cite ref="Beitzah 22a">Bets. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>קינס</he> Ms. M., v. <cite ref="S01571"><he>קְנִיבָה</he></cite>.]—Pl. <cite ref="S01195"><he>קִינְסֵי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Eruvin 100b:5">Erub. 100ᵇ</cite> <he>נתרי ק׳</he> (Ar. <he>קנסי</he>, ed. Sonc. <he>קסמי</he>) dry twigs will break off (by his being on the tree); [Ar. s. v. <he>קסן</he>, reads <cite ref="S00482"><he>קוּסְנֵי</he></cite>, cmp. <cite ref="S01078"><he>קִיסְנְיָיתָא</he></cite>].
